description: Lists snapshots in a project providing basic information per snapshot including name, id, status, creation time, disk size, storage bytes, source disk, and source disk id. Requires project as input.

inputSchema.description: Request message for listing snapshots basic info.

pageSize.description: Optional. The maximum number of snapshots to return.

pageToken.description: Optional. A page token received from a previous call to list snapshots.

project.description: Required. Project ID for this request.

name: list_snapshots

diskSizeGb.description: Size of the source disk, specified in GB.

id.description: The unique identifier for the snapshot.

sourceDisk.description: The source disk of the snapshot.

sourceDiskId.description: The source disk id of the snapshot.

storageBytes.description: A size of the storage used by the snapshot.

outputSchema.description: Response message for listing snapshots basic info.

nextPageToken.description: A token that can be sent as `page_token` to retrieve the next page. If this field is omitted, there are no subsequent pages.
